name: Telltale 1.8.0-beta.1
body:
## New in 1.8

- **Telltale comes as an installer.** Open the download and drag Telltale into Applications.
- **Settings fits your window.** The sheet grows with the window, fades where more is cut off, and a page inside it takes over the title with a back arrow.
- **What's new is in Settings.** It opens under About and help with New items first and Fixed folded, and Settings' own × closes it.
- **A cleaner chat header.** The title takes the free width, the line under it is the repo and the org, and Threads, Artifacts and Share sit in that order.
- **Pages have one close button.** A page's tab names its kind, and the Preview and Source controls sit on one row beneath it.
- **Logs open beside the chat.** The Ended marker's count opens a list of the chat's logs in the pane; Chat | Logs is gone unless a fix has files.
- **A list of logs.** Logs that touched your record come first, then other failures, with the clean ones folded in one row.
- **Ask about a line.** Pick a log line or a range, press Enter or Ask, and your reply carries a quote of those lines.
- **Show menu for log lines.** Problems, Everything, Queries, Data changes, Callouts or Debug lines, with search beside it.
- **People by name in logs.** Log rows and pane titles show who ran it and what ran in words, never a username or a REST path.
- **The Timeline has a door.** It opens from the pane's ⋯ menu, Open timeline.
- **Blocked notifications say so.** When macOS stops Telltale's notifications, Settings › General says it and has an Open Settings button.
- **A tidier repo page.** The folder shows as ~/work/app, never the full home path, and Memory, Knowledge and Packages come in that order.
- **Controls that answer you.** Options, Settings pages and toasts now slide or fade, and a theme change cross-fades. Reduce motion turns it off.
- **One Add connector button.** Connectors sit under Connected, Custom, Found on this Mac and Ready to connect; Add connector offers the list, a pasted config or the config file.
- **Say what's wrong beside the dot.** A connector that isn't green says Sign in again or Not checked beside its dot, with its switch and chevron after.
- **Connector pages carry their name.** Settings' title row shows the connector with a back arrow, and Open connector on a draft card lands on that connector.
- **Tools read in plain words.** Each tool shows what it does, its raw name under it, and the picked Allow, Ask or Off is filled and ticked.
- **Jira sign-in is one column.** The steps are a numbered list above the fields, and Get a token says why it waits.
- **Test your AI model.** Settings › Models has a Test button beside the model's state; the repeated Answers by row is gone.

## Fixed in 1.8

- **The working line says what your lead is doing.** While your lead reads the org, the code, a log or a ticket, the line names that read; with none out, it says your lead is thinking.
- **Short logs still show.** Two logs of under 100 ms, a second apart, are two visible marks in the strip and lanes of the Timeline.
- **The question bar fits the panel.** In the narrow side panel, the chip and the buttons stay inside the box instead of running past its edge.
- **API names stay whole in search.** A chat title or answer with Require_Region or Region__c keeps its underscores in search rows.
- **A calmer reply bar.** It reads + , org, reads, model, send. The org opens to show its kind and branch; Emoji is in the + menu.
- **One word for each org's kind.** The reply bar, the home picker and the reads tooltip all say Sandbox, Production or Production (not confirmed).
- **The home org picker opens below.** It no longer covers the reply box, and no org name is cut.
- **Stop works on a reply that got stuck.** A reply that was left spinning now ends as an error when you press Stop, and Try again is there.
- **Turning on logging from a chat says why it can't.** When the org refuses, the chat gives the cause and a next step, as the Start screen does.
- **The branch name is never cut to "ma…".** It moved from the reply bar into the org's popover, where it shows whole.
- **The reply bar keeps the org on a narrow chat.** Under 420 px the model shortens; the org keeps its dot and at least 8 characters.
- **A silent helper says so.** An answer that hears nothing says "Still working" after 30 seconds, and after 90 seconds offers Restart helper if the helper isn't answering.
- **One Stop while an answer runs.** The Stop in the reply box is the only one; "Answer with what you have" is the one text action beside the working line.
- **Each read is one line.** The file or object is named once; the full path is in the tooltip.
- **Waiting is said.** A question or failure waiting for the team says what it waits for, and a failure nobody is looking at no longer says "Checking…".
- **A failed reply has the fix.** After an expired sign-in the reply has Sign in again; after a refused key or connector it has Open Settings.
- **A lost reply ends on its own.** An answer whose turn was lost now ends with Try again after a couple of minutes instead of holding up your next question.
- **The logging chip keeps its words.** In a narrow header a long title gives way, not "Recording · 59 min left".
- **The relaunch notice clears Show sidebar.** With the sidebar hidden, the notice starts after the button, so you can click it.
- **A locked Keychain says so.** When Telltale can't read its saved key, it says to unlock the Keychain instead of saying no model is set up.
- **An expired sign-in says so.** While logging, the connection card says your sign-in ran out and has Sign in again, instead of "Can't reach Salesforce".
- **Logging that can't start says why.** A missing permission, API access that is off, or a sign-in that ran out each say what to do, with Salesforce's code at the end.
- **A quiet session tells you what to check.** After two minutes of logging with no log, the line says to check you are running the steps as the person you are logging.
- **A refused AI key shows up everywhere.** When your key is refused mid-chat, the reply box and Settings show it instead of looking healthy.
- **Chats are named from the answer.** A chat named from its first words takes the headline of its first finding. A name you typed is never changed.
- **Recording with Screen Recording off says so.** The bar says Not recording, and the end says Screen Recording was off.
- **Plainer words for Salesforce access.** Messages no longer show the name of the command line tool.
- **A failed send stays on the card.** It says why and offers Open connector and Send again; the draft is kept.
- **General has no repeated heads.** Your name, Appearance and While you test are the groups; Keyboard shortcuts and setup again are plain rows.
- **Privacy says what is always masked.** Text read from pictures is always masked, and saved recordings stay on this Mac, in one note.
